'''Mak Medagazy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who operated a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. In c. [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Medagazy was among a group of mercenary leaders that were summoned to the [[Sanctum Celestial]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]. There, Daiman briefed Medagazy and the other mercenaries about a planned ambush on the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord [[Odion]], which was set to take place on the world [[Gazzari]]. Afterwards, Medagazy flew to Gazzari and participated in the [[Battle of Gazzari|battle]] there.
